It is led by Marcus Cole, with Sarah Tan from the Analytics Department also noted as a lead in earlier communications. The project is scheduled to initiate in Q3 2023, with a kickoff meeting set for July 15th (though one email mentions a June 15th kick-off, the July date appears in the more detailed Q3 announcement).
